coverage_notes: The configured broad queries can return thousands of raw records, but realized volume is measured, never promised.
News aggregators cover many publishers; their top results are a bounded, ranked sample.
X, Stocktwits, private groups, Discord and Telegram channels are not directly collected without an authorized accessible feed. News reports about them are second-hand leads.
Reddit and Bluesky are accessible samples when their endpoints permit access, not whole-platform sentiment.
GDELT first-seen timestamps are discovery times, not verified original publication or event times.
